description: This file defines the 'Cookies' class within the Slim Framework's PSR-7 implementation. The class manages HTTP cookies, including their retrieval, setting, serialization to headers, and parsing from headers.

classes.name: Cookies
classes.description: A class for managing HTTP cookies in requests and responses, providing methods to get, set, and serialize cookies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Cookies object with optional cookies from the HTTP request.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default properties for cookies to be sent in responses.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cookie value by name from the request cookies.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a response cookie with specified properties.

methods.name: toHeaders
methods.description: Serializes response cookies into header strings for transmission.

methods.name: toHeader
methods.description: Converts a single cookie's properties into a Set-Cookie header string.
